name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Sections that expand and collapse; Disclosure is a single expandable section.

when: Long content people scan by heading, like an FAQ.

instead.when: Views are parallel and only one shows at a time.
The sections nest more than one level.

builtIn: Each header is a button with aria-expanded inside a heading.
youProvide: A heading level that fits the page.

genui.description: Expandable sections such as an FAQ. items are {id, title, content}.
